record.notes: Classified as paid-only rather than dead because the software is alive and maintained; what is gone is the hosted lane, and the two lead a reader to different decisions. This is the case an earlier rule is written for: a provider whose software is fine and whose free hosted capacity does not exist. The 2022 forum date is also the staleness warning: a 200 on the domain would have read as live to any check that did not look for a registration path.
